description: An agent-based model simulating the spread of mask-wearing behavior through social networks, influenced by social connections and government interventions.

behaviors.name: influence_others
behaviors.description: An agent attempts to influence others in their network to adopt or discard mask-wearing behavior.
behaviors.algorithm: Calculate influence based on network connections and weighted influence strengths; update neighbors' mask-wearing status probabilistically.

behaviors.name: change_mask_wearing_status
behaviors.description: Agents change their mask-wearing status based on received information and social influence.
behaviors.algorithm: If received information and social influence exceed risk perception threshold, change mask-wearing status.

interactions.name: InfluenceInteraction
interactions.description: A person influences another person in their network to adopt or discard mask-wearing behavior.
interactions.effect: Change in mask-wearing status of the influenced person.

algorithms.mask_adoption_decision: Threshold-based decision making for behavior change

data_sources.name: agent_attributes.csv
data_sources.purpose: Initialize agent attributes such as risk perception and initial mask-wearing status

data_sources.name: social_network.json
data_sources.purpose: Define social network structure and connections

data_sources.name: train_data.csv
data_sources.purpose: Train and validate behavior spreading model

files.name: main.py
files.description: Main simulation loop and model execution

files.name: agent.py
files.description: Defines the Person entity and its behaviors

files.name: network.py
files.description: Defines the Network entity and its behaviors

files.name: data_loader.py
files.description: Loads and preprocesses data from CSV and JSON files
